name: v1rus-flutter
description: Flutter and Dart layer for v1rus: layered architecture (core / design_system / domain / data / features) with boundaries enforced by an analyzer plugin, Bloc for screens and Cubit for components, one-shot effects as a separate stream, a sealed Result at the data boundary, Retrofit endpoint interfaces over Dio with auth refresh, Drift plus secure storage and preferences, get_it modules per feature, typed go_router routes, hand-written sealed models with equatable instead of a model generator, official ARB localisation, and the flutter-engineer and flutter-ui-developer agents.
